supported_conclusion: Independent scale-pattern formula is tested across seven public axes and in the complete-bank LOFO.

supported_conclusion: Centered and document-exact uncentered F2a/F2c, plus document CSP, have source-only matched wearing, MANUS session and GRAB unseen-user increments. Frozen validation-only reviews apply the existing default-bank guard.
remaining_boundary: Document-consistent F2c gains wearing F1/loss but worsens MANUS validation log loss and GRAB unseen-user F1/loss. No screened F2 addition clears the three-axis guard, so F0v2 remains the public-data default; these are not prospective independent tests.

supported_conclusion: Independent ring lag and correlation spectrum have seven-axis screens. Document-consistent uncentered ring covariance has a matched six-user public wearing screen with improved validation and descriptive-final F1/loss.
remaining_boundary: F3c is a wearing-specific research candidate: other public axes lack verified ring topology, and real own-device electrode re-donning remains unavailable. Historical RLCS/CES equivalence is superseded.

supported_conclusion: Frequency direction has seven-axis public screening and a four-tone known-signal check; personal spectral shift has Song and six-user MANUS repeated-session diagnostics and a matched predictive control.
remaining_boundary: MANUS F4d session-centering helps pooled validation and final F1 but final minimum-user F1 declines; medium-speed calibration versus slow/fast evaluation is speed-confounded. No measured-fatigue validation.

supported_conclusion: Validated G5, complete-bout DTW and optional order-two F5c have frozen native UniBo evidence; F5c rejects short windows and has a known-path oracle.
remaining_boundary: G5+F5c improves Day6 weighted macro F1 but worsens log loss; Days7-8 pooled F1 slips. Complete-bout oracle boundaries do not provide live onset/bout segmentation or eight-channel device transfer.

supported_conclusion: Real public IMU and oracle posture contexts have bounded native results; the calibrated body-frame API has rotation, trial-exclusion and independent 15-output analytical checks.
remaining_boundary: No native calibrated forward-axis/neutral-trial metadata support the proposed gravity-relative body-frame evaluation.

supported_conclusion: Public 0/1/2/5-shot score- and feature-space anchors plus frozen-source SPD tangent prototypes have native trial-aware evidence; Euclidean, standardized and cosine coordinates have an independent two-dimensional oracle.
remaining_boundary: Some high-dimensional classwise Mahalanobis options cannot be estimated from these shot counts; no universal gain.

supported_conclusion: Long-versus-current family-specific summaries are derived from source/calibration trials; public wearing and MANUS context controls plus one-person Song calibration-only Rest-noise shifts exist.
remaining_boundary: Song is same-person/same-day, S03 readiness failed and the Rest-noise descriptor has no matched predictive-routing increment; true later-day/re-donning validation is unavailable.

supported_conclusion: Availability-aware quality observations have direct-Fourier line/low-band, robust amplitude, neighbor-correlation and trace-covariance oracles. Frozen Song and GRAB F0 controls show the soft gate's false rejections; the separate severe structural rule rejects no natural Song, GRAB or electrode-re-wearing trials and detects copied constant channels.
remaining_boundary: The illustrative 0.5 gate rejects mostly correct F0 trials on Song and GRAB; the severe structural rule catches synthetic failures but no natural F0 errors. Physical-fault ground truth, independent own-device cohort and safe live gating remain unresolved.
